name: Niagara Falls Rainbow Predictor v1
lossFunction: L = 100 - V + 100 * hardVetoCount. Release only when hardVetoCount = 0 and V >= 92.

decisionClarity.goal: Answer whether to go, when to go, and where to stand without requiring weather interpretation.

dataPhysicsIntegrity.goal: Use live NWS grid data plus solar, antisolar, rainbow-angle, viewpoint and wind-driven mist geometry. Do not imply empirical probability calibration.

usefulness.goal: Provide today's strongest window, ranked viewpoints, an hourly curve and a multi-day alternative.

mobileAccessibility.goal: Remain usable at 390px, keyboard accessible, semantic and reduced-motion aware.

visualQuality.goal: Use a credible Niagara hero photograph and an editorial, non-dashboard visual hierarchy.

resilienceFreshness.goal: Expose source freshness, cache responsibly, time out stalled requests and never replace failed live data with synthetic weather.

seoSchemaAnalytics.goal: Own one distinct canonical intent with query-first metadata, entity/schema integrity, social image and inherited GA4.

hardVetoes: fake live weather or a hard-coded live opportunity score
missing GA4 G-Y5D2V2W7HN from the production build contract
displaying an unsupported precise probability instead of a rounded opportunity score
calibrationRule: Until the model has an empirical observation dataset, data/physics integrity is capped at 22/25. The UI must call the result an experimental opportunity score, not a calibrated probability.
benchmarkScenarios: heavy overcast suppresses otherwise favorable geometry
NWS upstream failure returns no synthetic fallback
source HTML ships no fake score
